cases.name: Allene Elizabeth “Beth” May Redmon
cases.about: A comment by Christina Moore on her obituary said, "Beth was my kids babysitter when they were younger. She was a beautiful person sweet, kind, funny, and giving. I'm glad I got to know her. She will be missed. Rest in Peace dear friend."
cases.narrative: On 11/24/2021, her body was found in a vacant lot in the area of Linda Lane in Harrisonburg.
